title: Type I materials.
officialText: Type I hoods shall be constructed of steel having a minimum thickness of 0.0466 inch (1.18 mm) (No. 18 gage) or stainless steel not less than 0.0335 inch (0.8525 mm) (No. 20 MSG) in thickness.
